reduced.purpose: Fast, source-package based rebuild for daily impact-triggered wiki updates.
reduced.typical_trigger: annual report, prospectus, or a very material disclosure after impact analysis.
reduced.output: compact reduced wiki suitable for downstream RAG and news impact reasoning.

full.purpose: Heavy research-loop build for initial or high-stakes company understanding.
full.typical_trigger: manual deep build, new company onboarding, or major model quality review.
full.output: long-form full wiki with research trace, valuation lens, and final writer synthesis.
